databases.name: ASCDB
databases.title: A Small(er) Chemistry Database
databases.blurb: A statistically representative database of 200 data points (350 geometries) distilled from GMTKN55, MGCDB84 and Minnesota 2015B, organised in 16 groups of chemical environments.

refs.text: Morgante, P.; Peverati, R. Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2019, 21, 19092-19103 (the ASCDB database).
GMTKN55: Goerigk, L.; Hansen, A.; Bauer, C.; Ehrlich, S.; Najibi, A.; Grimme, S. Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2017, 19, 32184-32215.
MGCDB84: Mardirossian, N.; Head-Gordon, M. Mol. Phys. 2017, 115, 2315-2372.
Minnesota 2015B: Yu, H.; He, X.; Truhlar, D. G. Chem. Sci. 2016, 7, 5032.
